conflicts.fact: Identity of the gas in the sukuma wiki bubbles and which process produced it
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4: partly CO2 from respiration plus O2 from photosynthesis. Lesson 5: CO2 from aerobic respiration. Lesson 8: bubbles are O2 from photosynthesis (CO2/respiration also mentioned). Lesson 9: gas produced by aerobic respiration. Lesson 11: bubbles were CO2 from respiration. Lesson 12: both CO2 and O2.
Lesson 4: plants produce ethanol + CO2 anaerobically. Lessons 5, 9: lactic acid in plant roots/bacteria and ethanol in yeast. Lesson 12: ethanol and CO2 (or lactate).
